title: Canonical tensor evaluation for ordinary ringed-site Hom complexes
statement: For a small ringed site (C,J,O), transport the total tensor/internalHom adjunction along homComplexFunctorObjIsoInternalHom, including its sign (-1)^(pn), to the ordinary product Hom of [def-pur-hom-complex]. Define E(P,N): N tensor Hom(P,O[0]) -> Hom(P,N) by braiding followed by the canonical ihomUnitTensorToIhom map. This map is natural contravariantly in every complex P and covariantly in every complex N, and is an isomorphism if P is dualizable as an ordinary complex. If u(N):N -> Hom(O[0],N) is the transpose of the tensor left unitor, then E(O[0],N) composed with tensoring u(O[0]) and the inverse right unitor is u(N). Tensor and the ring complex are exactly those of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system].

proof.text: Transport CochainComplex.tensorHomAdjunction along homComplexFunctorObjIsoInternalHom. The component transpose is (-1)^(pn) times the sheaf-level transpose on the (p,n) tensor summand. Compare components using this formula to identify precomposition for the transported closed structure with the actual homComplexFunctor source map.

Define E as braiding followed by MonoidalClosed.ihomUnitTensorToIhom. For a dualizable P, choose a right dual, convert it to a left dual using symmetry, and apply the proved isIso_ihomUnitTensorToIhom theorem. Both naturality equations follow by transposing and applying naturality of evaluation, associators and braiding.
For the tensor unit, transpose the desired equality. WhiskerLeft_unitNatIso_hom_app_ihom_ev_app cancels the unit-Hom transpose against evaluation, and monoidal coherence gives the left unitor.
